definitions.explanation: A reduction in the amount of tax levied by the government. Can refer to lowering tax rates, expanding deductions, or other measures that reduce the tax burden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{減税|げんぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government announced a tax cut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{所得税|しょとくぜい}→所得税：04913_shotokuzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{減税|げんぜい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: My take-home pay increased thanks to the income tax cut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺激|しげき}する→刺激する：20205_shigekisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{減税|げんぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実施|じっし}→実施：03275_jisshi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A significant tax cut was implemented to stimulate the economy.

notes:
{減税|げんぜい} refers to a reduction in taxes. A common term in news and political discourse.

FORMS:
{減|げん} (decrease) + ⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (tax). Can be used as a suru verb: {減税|げんぜい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to cut taxes).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{減税|げんぜい}: a large tax cut
- {減税|げんぜい}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: tax reduction measures
- {減税|げんぜい}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧: tax cut policy
- ⟦{所得税|しょとくぜい}→所得税：04913_shotokuzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{減税|げんぜい}: income tax cut

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{増税|ぞうぜい}→増税：12091_zouzei⟧: tax increase (antonym)
- ⟦{免税|めんぜい}→免税：09706_menzei⟧: tax exemption
- ⟦{節税|せつぜい}→節税：16469_setsuzei⟧: tax saving
- ⟦{脱税|だつぜい}→脱税：09000_datsuzei⟧: tax evasion
